description: This file implements the LocalStore class, which manages database operations such as opening a database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries. It interacts with a database connection and constructs SQL queries for data management within a specific plugin namespace.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local database storage, including opening connections, creating tables, setting limits, and CRUD operations on entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified path, creating the database file if necessary.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database with a specified name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a maximum page count limit on the database.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count and starting ID of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Fetches a list of entries from a specified table starting from a given index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a specified ID range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve a range of entries from a table.
